G1_unambiguity.justification: The set definitions, slot interval, precedence condition, exclusivity condition, and certificate meanings are stated precisely enough to determine the intended interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: All required input bounds, set cardinalities, slot range, constraints, output formats, and the promise about the applicable condition are provided.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Although the scheduling model is reformulated using sets, a valid per-job allocation exists exactly when \(p_{i,1}+p_{i,2}\le T\), and per-core disjoint allocations exist exactly when the corresponding total load is at most \(T\), matching the original certificates.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and grammatical, but terms such as “Strict Supremum Precedence” and the elaborate set-based reformulation feel contrived compared with the original scheduling description.
